title: Janitor for long-dead unverified accounts and their spent code grants
reason: P13 ships no sweep by design (a re-signup re-takes any address at any age), so unverified account rows and email_verification rows accumulate with nothing to remove them; verification_pending_since already doubles as the age stamp.
trigger: When the unverified count on production becomes noticeable, or the next backend housekeeping phase.
